other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.map_tree:
primrec map_tree :: "('a ⇒ 'b) ⇒ 'a tree ⇒ 'b tree" where
  "map_tree f Leaf = Leaf" |
  "map_tree f (Node l x r) = (Node (map_tree f l) (f x) (map_tree f r))"
formal function definitions.postorder:
fun postorder :: "'a tree ⇒ 'a list" where
  "postorder Leaf = []" |
  "postorder (Node (l) (x) (r)) = postorder l @ postorder r @ [x]"

formal theorem statement: theorem postorder_map: "postorder (map_tree f t) = map f (postorder t)"
